verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Jira's REST API and JQL are heavily used and valued for scripting and querying (jira-comm-11, jira-comm-14, jira-comm-17), and an official MCP server exists (jira-probe-3), but there's no documented OpenAPI spec discoverable via standard probes (jira-probe-1, jira-probe-2) and no evidence of full UI/API parity claims.
